records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 24 October 2026.

[2026-10-24_BCH]  
Video Title: Bitcoin Cash Golden Breakout: Can BCH Break Above 20-Week SMA Support?  
Video ID: 2djJaDrtUO4  
Bitcoin Cash (BCH) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
• Current trading price is $280, sitting just above the 20‑week SMA of $241 with a gap of roughly $40.  
• The asset is in a “golden breakout” zone, having risen 34% over the last 90 days, exhibiting momentum above median and risk below median.  
• Composite risk scores hover around 30% when combining 20‑, 100‑, and 200‑week SMAs, while the normalized risk oscillator remains below the 10% threshold that historically signals bottoms.  
• Social sentiment word‑cloud momentum is neutral on the Fear‑and‑Greed index, with no extreme bullish or bearish chatter detected.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
• TWAP baseline is anchored at the lifetime average of $425; current price is a 33% discount to this level.  
• The volume‑weighted average price (VWAP) sits at $43, making the current price roughly 30% above VWAP, yet the price remains below the time‑weighted average, flagging a risk level of 3 (30‑40%).  
• Regression analysis shows the price has moved from the 3‑σ max despair purple line (hit early June 2026) into the negative 2‑σ deep capitulation phase, with a residual zone of $270 as the lower max despair threshold.  
• Undervaluation residuals are evident: the asset trades at 34% below its lifetime average, while the 90‑day lookback shows a 34% upside potential.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
• Machine‑learning forecasts place the 10‑week non‑panic bare case at $185, the base case between $260 and $285, and the bull case between $315 and $425.  
• Panic‑drawdown support floor is projected at $228, with a deeper panic floor at $83, implying a potential 35% correction from current levels.  
• Macro moving‑average supports: 20‑week SMA at $241, 100‑week and 200‑week SMAs collectively keep risk below 30%.  
• Cycle bull target: a long‑term upside of up to 7× the current price, i.e., around $1,960, with a short‑term high of $1,270 if the red line (max 4 target) is breached.  

---
